nodes.definitions:
namespace Erdos155Fragment

def interval (lo hi : Nat) : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc lo hi

def sidon (S : Finset Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, ∀ d ∈ S,
    a + b = c + d → ((a = c ∧ b = d) ∨ (a = d ∧ b = c))

def difference_injective (A B : Finset Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ b₁ ∈ B, ∀ a₁ ∈ A, ∀ b₂ ∈ B, ∀ a₂ ∈ A,
    b₁ - a₁ = b₂ - a₂ → (b₁ = b₂ ∧ a₁ = a₂)

def check_instance (N k : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (∀ A ∈ (interval 1 N).powerset, ∀ B ∈ (interval (N + 1) (N + k)).powerset,
    A.card > k → sidon (A ∪ B) → difference_injective A B)

def check_fragment : Bool :=
  decide (∀ N ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 4} : Finset Nat),
    ∀ k ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset Nat), check_instance N k = true)

end Erdos155Fragment

nodes.claim: This kernel-decidable finite fragment checks, for every N ∈ {1,2,3,4} and k ∈ {1,2}, every A ⊆ [1,N] and B ⊆ [N+1,N+k] with |A| > k and A ∪ B Sidon has the property that equality of differences b₁−a₁ = b₂−a₂ forces (b₁,a₁) = (b₂,a₂).
